title: Drone to detect electromagnetic sources
description: This was a engeeniring school project. We had to build a drone to deteect a radio frequency source at 457Khz. We used ardupilot for the autonomous flight and radio anthena for the detection. We had to do a lot of research to find the right components and to make the drone fly autonomously. We also had to do a lot of testing to make sure that the drone was able to detect the source and to fly correctly.

title: Game of Life in SDL2
description: A 2D implementation of the Game of Life built with C and SDL2.

title: Tactis Arena
description: A 2D isometric multiplayer game built with C and SDL2. University project with a team of 4. The player control a team of characters with different abilities and fight against other players in an arena which have the same characters as the player.
